evidence.section: 8.7 Premier > Triage and Guided Response enhancements
evidence.statement: The 8.7 Cloud history places the combined Triage and Guided Response enhancements in Premier. The versioned 8.6 task and current 8.8 agent table describe the base Cloud agent for both editions with 10.2+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The 8.6 task excludes SecA1. Base scope does not establish enhancement eligibility.
